title: Saltreach Fen - Bone Mist
_note: Option B mood sibling. gbc 4-voice band. 6/8 compound, 92bpm, suspended D Dorian (raised 6th B-natural glints over minor). Sparser pulse25 lead, one drifting questioning phrase per two bars; faint pulse12 bell-buoy chime arpeggio in triplet lilt, once or twice a phrase; deep slow lilting compound rocking tri_bass (Tide signature); almost no drums - one soft noise 'wash' (hat) per phrase like mist moving. Vesper fragments: only the rising leap A3->D4->E4 survives, hanging unresolved; the settle home withheld until the very last bar, where it finally falls to D and voice-leads into the loop. 20 bars in 6/8; each bar = two dotted-quarters (6 eighths).
